Introduction

XngHan, formerly known as Seunghan, is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment and a former member of the boy group RIIZE. He was first introduced as part of the trainee group, SMROOKIES, on July 2, 2022, and debuted with RIIZE on September 4, 2023, with the single album "Get A Guitar".

Due to leaked personal information, he was indefinitely withdrawn from the group on November 21, 2023. Although his return was briefly announced on October 10, 2024, SM retracted the statement three days later, confirming his departure from RIIZE.

In June 2025, SM Entertainment announced that Seunghan would make his solo debut under the stage name XngHan, alongside the launch of creative project XngHan&Xoul. The “Xoul” part of the project refers to a rotating crew of collaborators. His debut single album "Waste No Time" was released on July 31, 2025, with the title track of the same name & b-side "Heavenly Blue".
